comment: Variants for .github/workflows/guest-memory.yml. query: page parameters added to the base; setup: shell commands typed into the guest right after sys.boot_completed=1 (experiments only; what is kept moves into web/js/boot-diet.js).

setup: Z=/sys/block/zram0; [ -e $Z ] || modprobe zram; echo lz4 > $Z/comp_algorithm; echo 384M > $Z/disksize && mkswap /dev/block/zram0 && swapon /dev/block/zram0; echo 100 > /proc/sys/vm/swappiness; cat /proc/swaps $Z/comp_algorithm
